title: The Left Ripple of Byte-Pair Encoding: Certified Lookbehind for Every Dictionary
abstract: arXiv:2611.13061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Berglund and van der Merwe formalized byte-pair encoding and bounded how far an appended string can change a tokenization, leaving the converse open: how far can a string prepended on the left change it, which dictionaries make that ripple infinite, and can it be computed efficiently when finite? We answer all three for every dictionary. The origin radius, how far a prepend can change covering spans, is decided with radius certificates by a product of two runs of the automaton that guesses the final tokens, in time polynomial in the dictionary written out, and it is infinite exactly when one periodic word has two canonical tilings with no common boundary. Under their ordering condition it is infinite exactly when some rule (t, t) finds its two copies adjacent at its own stage, and such a rule makes any dictionary infinite. translated_title: 字节对编码的左侧涟漪：面向任意词典的认证式回溯
translated_abstract: Berglund 与 van der Merwe 对字节对编码进行了形式化，并界定了在右侧追加字符串能在多大程度上改变分词结果，但留下了相反的问题未解决：在左侧前置一个字符串能在多大程度上改变分词结果？哪些词典会使这种涟漪无限延续？当涟漪有限时能否高效计算？本文针对任意词典完整回答了这三个问题。“起源半径”——即左侧前置能在多大范围内改变覆盖区间——由一个由自动机两次运行构成的乘积给出“半径证书”来判定，其运行时间关于写出词典的规模为多项式级；且该半径为无限，当且仅当存在某个周期词具有两个没有公共边界的规范铺砌。在他们的排序条件下，半径为无限当且仅当某条规则 在其自身阶段使其两个副本相邻，而这样的规则会使任何词典都产生无限涟漪。当半径有限时，宽度可由各半径读出的每个窗口都具有一个切割点，且半径有限当且仅当
tldr: 该论文对任意字节对编码词典完整解决了“左侧前置字符串能把分词改变多远”的问题：起源半径可由双自动机乘积给出的半径证书在多项式时间内判定，且恰好在存在一个具有两个无公共边界的规范铺砌的周期词（在排序条件下即某规则 的两个副本在其自身阶段相邻）时为无限。
en_tdlr: This paper fully resolves, for every BPE dictionary, how far a left-prepended string can ripple through a tokenization: the origin radius is certified and decidable in polynomial time via a product of two automaton runs, and is infinite exactly when a periodic word has two canonical tilings with no common boundary (equivalently, under the ordering condition, when some rule (t,t) finds its two copies adjacent at its own stage).
